title: Threshold
summary: Configurable community funding with sponsor matching, milestones and reviewer approvals.
cardSummary: Explore community funding, sponsor matching and milestone approvals through a walletless simulation and Rust contract source.
reviewNote: November 19, 2026: the current public site describes a walletless simulation. No current mainnet deployment is established by these sources.
